text: Aaj ka din Aries ke liye energy se bharpur rahega. Suryadev aapke swabhav ko aur bhi tej banayenge, jisse aap har mushkil ka samna himmat se karenge. Career me koi purani rukavat door ho sakti hai, lekin senior se baat karte waqt vinamr rehna zaroori hai. Paisa aayega par kharcha bhi badhega, isliye budget banana samajhdari hogi. Rishton me chhoti baat ko bada na banayein. Sehat ke liye subah ka thoda vyayam aur paani adhik peena faydemand rahega.

Aaj aapki kismat ka taara buland rahega. Mangal ki sthiti aapko naya utsah degi aur kisi atke hue kaam me safalta milegi. Office me aapki mehnat ki tareef hogi, par doosron ki salah ko nazarandaz na karein. Parivar me kisi bade sadasya ka aashirwad milega jo mansik shanti dega. Achanak koi purana mitra mil sakta hai. Khane-peene me santulan rakhein, warna pet ki gadbad ho sakti hai. Raat ko jaldi sona aapke liye best rahega.

Beeta hua kal aapke liye thoda utar-chadhav wala raha. Subah ke waqt thodi jhunjhahat mehsoos hui, lekin dopahar tak sthiti sudhar gayi. Kisi kaam me deri hui jisse mann ashant raha. Ghar me kisi chhoti baat par bahas ho sakti thi. Paisa related koi purana mamla sar pe aaya. Lekin shaam ko kisi apne se baat karke mann halka hua. Sehat me thakan zyada thi, isliye aaram karna zaroori tha. Aaj se seekh lein aur aage badhein.

Kal aapka din madhyaam raha. Kuch kaam samay par poore nahi ho paye jisse thodi nirasha hui. Career me kisi colleague se matbhed ki sthiti bani, lekin baat samajhne ke baad sab theek ho gaya. Parivar ka sahyog mila aur maa ke haath ka khana khane ka mauka mila. Kharcha thoda zyada ho gaya tha. Sehat ki drishti se halki thakan aur neend ki kami rahi. Din ke ant me kisi shubh samachar ne mann ko prasann kar diya.

Aane wala kal aapke liye shubh sanket lekar aa raha hai. Surya ki kripa se aatmvishwas badhega aur koi naya kaam shuru karne ka mauka milega. Career me senior ka sahyog milega, isliye jaldbazi na karein. Vyapar me naya grahak judega jisse aamdani badhegi. Ghar me kisi mangal kaam ki taiyari ho sakti hai. Rishton me madhurta banegi. Sehat achhi rahegi, bas subah ka nashta skip na karein. Kisi shubh vastu ka gift mil sakta hai.

Kal ka din aapke liye bahut hi faldayak rahega. Kisi purane vivaad ka ant hoga aur mann ko shanti milegi. Office me aapki ek nayi yojana ko sarahna milegi. Paisa aane ke yog hain, khas taur par kisi purane lend se. Doston ke saath samay bitane ka mauka milega. Parivar me kisi shubh avsar ki charcha hogi. Sehat ke liye subah walk aur pranayam karein. Raat ko halka khana khayein. Kismat aapka saath degi.

Is hafte Aries ke liye mehnat aur safalta ka sangam rahega. Shuruaat me thodi bhaag-daud rahegi, lekin mid-week tak sab kuch control me aa jayega. Career me naye project ki zimmedari milegi jo aapki kshamta ko ujagar karegi. Paisa aayega par kharch bhi badhega, isliye faltu shopping se bachein. Rishton me vishwas badhega aur kisi purane mitra se mulakat hogi. Sehat me halki sardi ya khansi ho sakti hai, isliye garm kapde pehnein. Weekend par parivar ke saath samay bitana shubh rahega.

Is saptah aapko apne lakshya par dhyan dena hoga. Sitaron ki chaal keh rahi hai ki jaldbazi nuksan degi. Career me kisi colleague ki salah se bada fayda hoga. Paison ke mamle me savdhani rakhein, kisi anjaan par bharosa na karein. Ghar me maa ya patni ki sehat par dhyan dein. Rishton me samay ke saath sudhar hoga. Kisi shubh karyakram me shirkat karne ka mauka milega. Hafte ke ant me koi achhi khabar sunne ko milegi jo aapka utsah badha degi.

Is mahine Aries ke liye naye avsar ke dwar khulenge. Surya aur Mangal ki sthiti aapko aage badhne ki himmat degi. Career me promotion ya salary badhne ke yog hain, lekin kisi se jalne ki bajay apni mehnat par bharosa karein. Paison ki sthiti sudhregi, purana karz chukane ka mauka milega. Prem jeevan me nayi urja aayegi aur kisi khaas insaan se rishta gahra ho sakta hai. Sehat ke liye niyamit dincharya apnayein. Mahine ke ant me koi mangal karya sambhav hai.

Yeh mahina aapke liye aatmvikas ka samay hai. Shuruaat ke kuch din thodi uljhan me guzrenge, lekin 10 tareekh ke baad grah sthiti sudhregi. Karya kshetra me aapki raay ko mahatva milega. Vyapar karne walon ko naya sauda mil sakta hai. Paisa aa raha hai par kharcha bhi hai, isliye bachat par dhyan dein. Parivar me kisi shubh samachar ki pratiksha hai. Sehat me pet aur neend se jude mudde ho sakte hain. Kisi teerth sthan ki yatra ka yog bhi ban sakta hai.

Sehat ke liye sharirik vyayam aur santulit ahar zaroori hai. Varsh ke ant me koi samman ya puraskar milne ke yog hain.
